name: Spain (state + Comunidad de Madrid)
kernel_gaps: Out/countryMain write whole units; Spain liquidates in cents (own JSON writer)
Canon rounds input amounts to whole euros (cents read from raw JSON)
statutory tables with a printed cumulative cuota column (Row/tableTax; proved equal to the kernel band sum, rounded)
the 'minimo at the bottom of the scale' construction tax(base) - tax(minimo) (cuotaMinusMin)
all-or-nothing deductions with income limits (notches) are not a kernel part
withholding procedure (RIRPF arts. 81-86) with a 43 % cap

validation.notes: 8 types x 6 lines. State side (CGTC, CGITFP incl. refundable art. 81 bis, EECSSC, CTGG): 32/32 within 0,76 EUR (OECD wages rounded to the euro). SLT 0/8 and THP 0/8: the OECD uses a weighted combination of regional schedules, not Madrid (F1).
Implemented clause by clause from RIRPF arts. 81-86; agrees with the regulation except two conventions (truncation of the tipo; top withholding rate 47 %). No published numeric cases.

validation.referee: AEAT IRPF 2025 guide + bulletin on Ley 5/2025
validation.notes: Parameter check only (DA 61.a thresholds, SMI 16.576); no official worked example found.

headline: State income tax matches the OECD to the cent on all 8 households; the withholding rules were not updated for the 2025 minimum wage, so a minimum-wage worker who owes nothing is withheld 300 EUR, and all-or-nothing limits (6.500 EUR other income; Madrid family deductions) cost up to 1.650 EUR for one more euro.
